_meta: Snapshot of cs170k eval_accuracy_genmatch values from the original strict parser (parse_true_false only), preserved before the broad-parser re-run on 2026-05-23. The broad-parser re-run overwrites eval_accuracy_genmatch in each metrics.json; this file is the only record of the strict-parser numbers. See commit 9045e19 for the broadened parser. The strict view is also interesting in its own right: it measures how strongly the adapter overrode the BoolQ eval prompt's 'yes/no' instruction with its cs170k 'true/false' training format — i.e. format-adaptation strength, not task accuracy.
